rules.message: Duplicate NSAID therapy detected: Prescribing two or more systemic NSAIDs concurrently offers no additional analgesic benefit while exponentially compounding gastrointestinal bleed, renal impairment, and cardiovascular event risk.

provenance.source: WHO Guidelines on the Pharmacological Treatment of Persisting Pain
citations: World Health Organization. WHO Guidelines for the Pharmacological and Radiotherapeutic Management of Cancer Pain in Adults and Adolescents. Geneva: WHO; 2018.

rules.message: Duplicate Benzodiazepine therapy detected: Concurrent administration of multiple benzodiazepines produces additive central nervous system and respiratory depression.

provenance.source: FDA Boxed Warning on Benzodiazepine Use
citations: FDA Drug Safety Communication: FDA requiring boxed warning updated to improve safe use of benzodiazepine drug class (September 2020).
